topic: The Architecture of Rhythm: Music and Measure Theory

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Pulse of Time
lecture_lines: Time flows in a constant steady pulse.
We call each unit a beat.
Imagine these as equally spaced dots.
animations: Display a steady pulse line across the center (#FFFFFF) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/heart.svg].
Highlight individual beats as growing circles (#FFFF00) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/metronome.svg].
Sequence beats in a linear progression (#00FF00) incorporating [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drum.svg].

sections.title: The Concept of Measures (Bars)
animations: Draw a large empty rectangle frame using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/container.svg] (#FFFFFF).
Insert vertical bar lines dividing the space (#00FFFF).
Place beat markers represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/box.svg] inside each divided section (#FF8000).

sections.title: Decoding the Time Signature
animations: Animate a whole note dividing into four quarters (#FFCC00) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/map.svg] as a visual guide.
Group four quarter notes into one measure (#00FF00).

sections.title: Dynamic Application: The Accent Pattern
animations: Display a standard pulse grid (#FFFFFF) with a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/metronome.svg] as a visual tempo reference.
Enlarge the first beat with a glow effect (#FF00FF) using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drumstick.svg] to highlight the strike.
Animate the accent moving periodically through the pattern (#FF00FF).

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
animations: Assemble the pulse line and measure box using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blueprint.svg] (#FFFFFF).
Overlay the time signature symbol onto the structure (#00FF00).
Flash all components to illustrate rhythmic unity (#FFFF00).
